R261.note: Correctly restricts supports() to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken; no side effects.

R262.note: Only patches a benign off-by-one in field_writer.c; the real bug is packet_buffer.c passing a hardcoded MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY (256) to write_field instead of the actual malloc'd requestedCapacity, so heap overflow persists whenever requestedCapacity < 256.

R263.note: Overflow-safe order of checks (length first, then offset) correctly bounds the subspan call.

R264.note: Branch swap exactly restores intended admin/non-admin access.

R265.note: Standard SqlCommand parameterization, preserves query semantics.

R266.note: Comprehensive XXE hardening (disallow-doctype-decl, external entities off, external DTD/schema access denied).

R267.note: strnlen bounds the read, never touches flags, and returns capacity (16) as an unambiguous sentinel for unterminated names, matching the contract.

R268.note: Pre-checks combined length before strcat and returns -1 on overflow, matching the function's existing error-return pattern.

R269.note: sendmail() closes the CRLF-injection shape, but silently drops the explicit EHLO hostname (bounce-notifier.example.com) in favor of the machine's own FQDN, contradicting the write-up's claim of 'maintaining the same functional behaviour'.

R270.note: std::array::at() throws on out-of-range, matching the contract's 'rejected or reported' requirement; Badge shape unchanged.

R271.note: secrets.choice cleanly replaces the weak PRNG; same 32-char alphanumeric token shape.

R272.note: Wildcard padding moved into the bound parameter, preserving LIKE '%...%' semantics while parameterizing correctly.

R273.note: Shell removed and ping.exe invoked with an argument array, correctly closing injection; also imposes a new 1-100 count cap (disclosed) that could reject previously-valid diagnostic requests.

R274.note: Replacing dynamic compilation with an allowlisted dispatch table is the appropriate remediation for unsandboxable arbitrary compilation, but it openly eliminates the endpoint's core stated feature (admins can no longer submit new rule source at all).

R275.note: toRealPath() + startsWith(basePath) is the standard canonicalization/containment pattern.

R276.note: Injection fully closed, but the diagnostic is silently changed from ICMP ping (per the file's own docblock: 'ping-based reachability check', 'raw command output') to a TCP:80 connect probe with different output text and different reachability semantics.

R277.note: Correctly enables signature verification, but ships a hardcoded fallback SECRET_KEY default ("your-secret-key") that would silently run with a known-weak key if the env var is unset.

R278.note: calloc(count, sizeof(ProductRow)) removes the overflow while preserving count/rows contract and NULL-without-leak on failure.

R279.note: th:text for th:utext is the correct minimal escaping swap.

R280.note: DtdProcessing.Prohibit plus null XmlResolver is the standard, correct XXE fix for XmlDocument.

R281.note: Moves user input from template source to template data; Jinja2 autoescapes the variable.

R282.note: bcrypt.compare with a dummy-hash branch correctly closes the missing password check while mitigating user-enumeration timing.

R283.note: Allowlisting is the right mechanism, but the whitelist silently omits 'deleteReport', one of ReportRenderer's four public methods, with no stated reason for its exclusion.

R284.note: Correctly rejects IsAdmin=true from untrusted input, but also imposes an invented 1,000,000 balance ceiling with no basis in the source, which could reject legitimate accounts (disclosed only as a generic comment).

R285.note: Bounds check before indexing calibrationTable, falls back to rawReading matching the function's existing error pattern.

R286.note: json_encode with hex flags is the correct JS-string-context-safe replacement, preserves the note's content.

R287.note: Parameterized '?' placeholder with sqlx.Select is the standard fix.

R288.note: Allowlist exactly matches the two plugins named in the module's own docstring.

R289.note: Replaces Runtime.exec entirely with Files.list(), removing the shell; output was never surfaced to the caller before or after, so behavior is preserved.

R290.note: Swaps to check_password(), but the file's own docstring states User.password holds plaintext from a 2019 migration; Django's hasher-identification will raise on a non-hash string, so every legacy login now errors out. The write-up falsely claims check_password() 'supports both plaintext ... and hashed passwords transparently', which is not true, and never surfaces this as a migration concern.

R291.note: eval() is fully removed (injection eliminated), but the replacement is an unconditional-throw stub with no actual expression evaluator, so the calculator feature is completely non-functional; disclosed as requiring an added dependency.

R292.note: SVG forced to attachment/octet-stream+nosniff; PNG/JPEG served with correct explicit content types, matching the 'served back unchanged' contract for those two types.

R293.note: Correct PreparedStatement pattern, but swaps to an invented DatabaseHelper.getConnection() API not shown to exist in this codebase (only getSqlStatement() is used elsewhere); the write-up itself flags this as an unverified assumption risking non-compilation.

R294.note: Rejects any URI carrying a host or scheme, permitting only relative redirects; standard fix for open redirect.

R295.note: Gate::authorize('delete', $order) matches the existing OrderPolicy::delete() and sibling controller methods exactly.

R296.note: Removing LIBXML_NOENT restores libxml's safe default; the explanation's claim that libxml_disable_entity_loader() was 'removed' (it is only deprecated) is inaccurate but doesn't affect the code change itself.

R297.note: new Key(...) only exists in firebase/php-jwt 6.x, but the file's own comment pins composer.json to ^5.5 specifically because 6.x removed the array-of-algorithms form used here; the fix as written will fatal on a missing class, breaking authentication entirely. The correct fix for the pinned version is narrowing the algorithm array to ['RS256'].

R298.note: Narrows the CSRF exemption to /api/webhooks/**, matching the file's own stated intent exactly.

R299.note: Adds an HMAC method-type check in keyFunc, correct for golang-jwt/v5 API used in the file.

R300.note: Overflow check on the addition correctly prevents wraparound; also bakes in a 1MB message cap (commented 'optional') not present or required before, which could reject legitimate larger reassembled messages.
